النّصّ 07، التّعبير الكتابيّ 06). نُسخ النص من صورة الورقة الرسمية (لا نسخة Word): الملفّ PDF رقميّ له طبقة نصّ أصليّة، فأُخذت الحروف منها (pdftotext -raw: علامات الاقتباس المنحنية، «…»، «§»، «–»، نقاط الفراغات) وطوبقت سطرًا سطرًا مع صور الصّفحات (150 نقطة، ورؤوس جداول النّطق بـ400 نقطة)، وتُحقِّق بسكربت من أنّ كلّ نصّ حرفيّ وكلّ اقتباس في الخطوات جزء من طبقة النّصّ. خلاف طبقة النّصّ والصّورة: السّنة والمدّة في الرّأس العربيّ معكوسة («0302»، «30 … 03») وصوابها في الصّورة «2026» و«03 سا و30 د»؛ رمز «/ɪd/» و«/ɪz/» مطبوع بحرف I كبير مصغَّر وطبقة النّصّ تكتبه «I» فحُفظ «/Id/» و«/Iz/» كما في الطّبقة؛ التّسطير والخطّ الغامق لا يظهران في طبقة النّصّ وحُدّدا من الصّورة. قرارات التّحويل (R1–R11 في محوّل التّجربة build_en_bac_2019_lit.py و D1–D7 في رأس هذا المحوّل): عنصر لكلّ بند يُنقَّط منفردًا؛ نعم/لا اختيار من خيارين مخزَّنان معكوسين؛ «نعم/لا + علّل» عنصران (0.25 + 0.75) كما في السّلّم؛ صيغ الحلّ المتعدّدة للإجابة نفسها تبقى تفاعليّة ولا تُعرض صيغة مقبولة مشتّتًا؛ جداول النّطق اختيار من متعدّد لكلّ كلمة (0.25) لأنّ كلمتين تقعان في العمود نفسه؛ إعادة التّرتيب: الجملة الافتتاحيّة وكلّ زوج منطقيّ (0.5 لكلّ منها)؛ ما يقبل فيه الحلّ «أيّ إجابة منطقيّة» (العنوان، الفكرة العامّة) مؤجَّل essay_builder؛ التّعبير الكتابيّ مؤجَّل بمعايير الشّبكة الرّسميّة «LE» (الملاءمة 1.5، الانسجام الدّلاليّ 1، سلامة اللّغة 2، الإتقان 1.5). الموضوع الأوّل: المسطَّر في النّصّ They (§1 «They became well-known»)، whose (§2 «Roman policy whose objective»)، It (§3 «It remained largely restricted»)، وفي B3 «to disseminate the ideals of the Roman cities.» و«in Souk Ahras.»؛ تذكر كلّ خطوة الجملة والجزء المسطَّر. تنبيه للمالك (D7): عمود /d/ في الحلّ «studied / replied» والورقة «represented - established - studied - applied»؛ «replied» ليست في الورقة و«applied» هي الكلمة الوحيدة الباقية بعد ملء الخانات الثّلاث الأخرى، فجُعلت /d/ — يُرجى التّأكّد. س3ج: «No» (0.25) والتّعليل (0.75) عنصران؛ التّعليل بلفظ النّصّ الّذي يقتبسه الحلّ («Access to education, however, was not open to all. It remained largely restricted to a specific social class.»؛ الحلّ يحذف «however»). س5 العنوان: «Accept any logical title» فمؤجَّل مع عنوان الحلّ نموذجًا. ملء الفراغات (0.5×4) خطوة واحدة لأنّ التّنقيط الجزئيّ للمحرّك يطابق السّلّم؛ البنك هو قائمة الورقة (6 كلمات لأربعة فراغات). المجموع 20 = 7 + 7 + 6 (تفاعليّ 13، مؤجَّل 7: العنوان 1 + التّعبير 6).

documents.caption: The text
documents.text:
During the Roman period, specifically in the fourth century A.D, the schools of Thagaste and Madauros were two of the most prominent ones in Algeria. They became well-known due to the nature of their educational programme applied in the learning process. These institutions represented a fundamental cornerstone in shaping and refining the intellectual character of a number of African literary elites who trained and studied there. Thanks to the strength of their instructions, these schools enabled writers to leave a clear imprint and a significant legacy on Latin literature.
The spread of these schools in Africa coincided with Roman policy whose objective was to establish such institutions throughout the settlements. This expansion aimed to meet the needs of Roman citizens and Italian settlers, while also serving as an instrument for the diffusion of Romanization among Africans. Through these schools, Rome sought to disseminate the ideals of the Roman cities and implement its settlement and pacification policy.
Access to education, however, was not open to all. It remained largely restricted to a specific social class – members of the local elite or the sons of landowners – who could afford the considerable expenses of schooling. Their primary motivation was to secure prestigious administrative positions for their children within the Roman system or to ensure their upward mobility within the Roman social hierarchy.

documents.caption: Source
documents.text:
Adapted from: “Science, Education and Innovation in the Context of Modern Problems”
Issue 10, Vol. 8.2025 - by Hassina Hallak.

original_questions.verbatim_text:
Choose only ONE of the following topics.
Topic One:
There is a great deal of discussion about the role of Roman schools in shaping the African culture. Some claim that the Roman civilization did not have any influence on the African culture. As a member of the cultural club of your school, write an opinion article of about 80 to 120 words for your club magazine in which you highlight the role of the Roman schools in Africa, namely Algeria.
Make the best use of the following notes:
- Teaching Roman culture (Latin language / law / philosophy)
- Integrating the Africans into the Roman empire
- Mixing the Roman traditions with the African ones.
- Helping preserve classical knowledge in Africa ( philosophy, arts and civic values)
Topic Two:
You have recently taken an exam and noticed that some of your classmates have used the Artificial Intelligence (AI) to cheat. You felt disappointed and decided to react. Write an article of about 80 to 120 words for your school journal to denounce such an unethical practice.

Some claim that the Roman civilization did not have any influence on the African culture. As a member of the cultural club of your school, write an opinion article of about 80 to 120 words for your club magazine in which you highlight the role of the Roman schools in Africa, namely Algeria.
notes: - Teaching Roman culture (Latin language / law / philosophy)
- Integrating the Africans into the Roman empire
- Mixing the Roman traditions with the African ones.
- Helping preserve classical knowledge in Africa ( philosophy, arts and civic values)

topics.text: You have recently taken an exam and noticed that some of your classmates have used the Artificial Intelligence (AI) to cheat. You felt disappointed and decided to react. Write an article of about 80 to 120 words for your school journal to denounce such an unethical practice.

spec.grid: Criteria: relevance | semantic coherence | correct use of English | Excellence (vocabulary & creativity) | Final score — LE: 1.5 | 1 | 2 | 1.5 | 6 points

spec.rubric: Correct use of English: 2 pts (official grid)

steps.explanation: Scored with the official grid: Relevance 1.5 – Semantic coherence 1 – Correct use of English 2 – Excellence (vocabulary & creativity) 1.5 = 6 pts.
